components.title: RKE2 cluster
components.description: The Kubernetes distribution of a site: RKE2 in its FIPS build, CIS profile, Canal networking.

control-implementations.description: What the site stack's rendered manifests show about the cluster distribution.

implemented-requirements.description: The site stack renders no k3s component.

statements.description: Every release of the site stack, rendered offline from the hash-checked vendored charts with the CI site file, contains no k3s name, image or label; the render test fails on any match outside the generated values of a Secret.
statements.remarks: Your organization installs the site's cluster with RKE2 and keeps k3s to lab and demonstration rigs.
